The treatment from ADR 0056 (extracting absorbing verbs, flattening declaration tables, splitting colocated domains) is effective but was never applied to the high-centrality second-tier modules now causing blockage
Seam tests asserting per-file headroom targets under 700 LOC serve as the substitute ratchet after per-function length gates were rejected as too high blast radius
Extracted modules must meet anti-fragmentation requirements (minimum 100 LOC) and every relocation must relocate mass without requiring edits to existing tests
The plan-review step-registry membership and gates/plan-review.yaml resolution are not caught statically today and require new test guards
gen_env_registry.py has a scanner defect where _llm_float helper reads are invisible
